top_signals.title: Nordic Power Prices Could Soar This Winter as Hydropower Reserves Plunge
top_signals.summary: Low water levels in hydropower reservoirs and soaring natural gas prices are putting upward pressure on power prices in the Nordic countries as winter approaches, Denmark-based energy trader Mind Energy says.
